title: Jharkhand Teacher Eligibility Test JHTET 2026 Apply Online Form (Primary & Junior Level)
intro: Jharkhand Teacher Eligibility Test (JHTET) has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for the Jharkhand Teacher Eligibility Test (JHTET 2026) Exam 2026.  Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Syllabus, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to Jharkhand JHTET 2026 Jobs. Online Apply Start On June 20, 2026 & Last Date for Application is May 21, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Online Apply Start On : 21 April 2026
Registration Last Date : 20 June 2026
Fee Payment Last Date : 20 June 2026
Admit Card Available :  Notify Later
Exam Date : Notify Later
Answer Key Available :  Notify Later
Paper-I or II
General/ BC/ EWS Candidates : Rs. 1300/-
SC/ ST/ PH Candidates : Rs. 700/-
Primitive Tribe : Rs. 500/-
Both Paper-I & II
General/ BC/ EWS Candidates : Rs. 1500/-
SC/ ST/ PH Candidates : Rs. 800/-
Primitive Tribe : Rs. 600/-
Payment Mode: Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card/ Credit Card/ Net Banking or Offline Fee Mode Only.

Passed 10+2 Intermediate / Higher Secondary with at least 50% marks and completed a 2-Year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed / BTC / equivalent) recognized by NCTE. Candidates admitted in training session on or after 09 December 2007 are eligible.

Passed 10+2 Intermediate / Higher Secondary with minimum 45% marks and completed a 2-Year Diploma in Elementary Education as per NCTE Regulations 2002. Candidates admitted before 09 December 2007 are eligible.
Passed 10+2 Intermediate / Higher Secondary with at least 50% marks and completed 4-Year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed).
Passed 10+2 Intermediate / Higher Secondary with minimum 50% marks and completed 2-Year Diploma in Education (Special Education).
Graduation Degree in any stream with 2-Year Diploma in Elementary Education.
Important Note: Candidates must check the official Jharkhand JHTET 2026 notification for detailed eligibility, reservation relaxation, and certificate validity before applying online.
Graduation Degree in relevant subject with at least 50% marks and passed / appearing in 1-Year B.Ed.
Graduation Degree in relevant subject with minimum 45% marks and passed / appearing in 1-Year B.Ed. as per NCTE norms.
Passed 10+2 / Intermediate with at least 50% marks and completed / appearing in 4-Year B.A. B.Ed. / B.Sc. B.Ed. Integrated Course.
Graduation Degree with minimum 50% marks and completed / appearing in 1-Year B.Ed. (Special Education).
Post Graduation Degree with at least 55% marks and completed / appearing in 3-Year Integrated B.Ed. – M.Ed. Course.

Subject Wise Requirement:

																Candidates must have studied the concerned subject in Graduation / Post Graduation for applying as Upper Primary Teacher (Class 6 to 8).

Applicants are advised to read the official Jharkhand JHTET 2026 Notification carefully for complete eligibility details, age limit, reservation benefits, and certificate verification process before applying online.
21 April 2026: Online Application Started!
20 June 2026: Last date for registration & fee.
To Be Notified: Exam Date, Admit Card, Result.
No specific upper age limit for JHTET (as per NCTE norms).
Candidates must fulfill educational qualification.
10+2 with 50% marks + D.El.Ed / BTC OR B.El.Ed OR Graduation + B.Ed
Graduation with 50% marks + B.Ed OR 10+2 with 50% + 4-Year B.A/B.Sc B.Ed
Eligibility for Government Teacher Jobs in Jharkhand
Valid for 7 Years
